args:
#!/bin/sh
log="$(dirname "$0")/ffmpeg.log"
printf "ARGS:" >> "$log"; for a in "$@"; do printf " [%s]" "$a" >> "$log"; done; echo >> "$log"
prev=""; for a in "$@"; do if [ "$prev" = "-i" ]; then echo "LIST:" >> "$log"; cat "$a" >> "$log"; fi; prev="$a"; done
exec /usr/bin/ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error "$@"
